<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2032023-07-2115-18-30" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Conclusive verses (209a5–209a8)"/>
	<milestone n="1." unit="section"/>
	<lg><l>dge legs yon tan kun gyi gzhi' ||</l> <l>shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul ||</l> ston pa nyid kyis legs gsungs shing || <l>de'i gsal byed <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">mngon rtogs rgyan</rs> ||</l> <l><rs type="deity">mgon po</rs> yis ni sbyar ba mdzad ||</l> <l>de dag rnaM par 'byed pa ni ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">bla ma seng ge bzang po</rs>s <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="209a6"/> mdzad ||</l> 
	<l>de dag rnaM par <choice><corr>'thad</corr><orig>'thag</orig></choice> pa ni ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma daM pa</rs>'i rjes 'brangs nas ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">shag kya'i dge slong byang ye</rs>s byas ||</l></lg> </seg></TEI>
